items.title: DEV_NET Phase One Routed
items.summary: The public mirror is expanding from a single index into a multipage armory, attachment database, project board, documentation gateway, and console-driven network.

items.title: M4 Platform Capture Added
items.summary: The M4 development capture replaced the retired secondary rifle record. Animation and integration work remain active.

items.title: SIMD Reload Pipeline Stabilized
items.summary: Targeted import path confirmed. One clip updates, the original bank stays intact, and the animation list does not duplicate itself on export.

items.title: Tactical Stance Calibration
items.summary: Canted aim offsets moved into live tuning. Animation carries the stance; calibration carries the sight line.

items.title: Attachment Modularity Pass
items.summary: Rails, optics, and scope bones are being split into modular targets so custom hardware can be validated without rewriting the whole weapon.
